main_text.p: cunq; tùm Romulus, tùm Augustus construxerant, sub ipso Barbari di-ruerunt.
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Orientis Imperium permul-ta adhuc secula floruit: Sed & il-lud partim à Scythis, partim à Saracenis ita debilitatum fuit, ut præter urbem Constantinopolim & vicinas quasdam provincias vix quicquam obtineret, donec tandem A.C.1453. h. e. ante 200. ferè annosà Mahummede Turcarum Imperatore, captâ Constantinopoli penitùs extinguere,[?] tur;
main_text.head: HISTORIA NOVA sive RECENTIOR.

page.notes: The left margin holds the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The faint ghost text in the right margin and below the title block is show-through and is not transcribed. "extinguere," ends a line with no visible hyphen before "tur;", so the join is uncertain and marked. The running head "Romanorum," and page number 27 are as printed; the 2 in "Explicatio 2." is followed by a flourish that may be a printer's mark.
